own_solution.law: Static equilibrium of ladder against smooth wall: N = (m+M) g, F_wall = (m/2 + M x) g / tan(theta), |F_ground| = sqrt(N^2 + F_wall^2).

notes: Verified: theta=48: F_wall = 470.4*0.90040 = 423.55 N, |F| = 908.39 N; theta=44: 939.71 N; theta=40: F_wall = 470.4*1.19175 = 560.60 N, |F| = 979.82 N; base 841.62 N. Length cancellation expression correct. Minimal pairs T49C6/TCE71 (earlier experiment vs before person stood, both 18 deg) and TEA7A/TD573 (shutter vs ladder, both 18 deg) differ only in attachment. Earlier-experiment tilt leaves no state because the stated angle is the outset angle of this experiment. Numeral-free controls T1EB2 and TA81B are declared.
